evidence.scope: Add the harness's decision layer: typed questions asked of Jev at the stage gates, recorded with their probabilities, with a human fallback whenever the API cannot answer, and thresholds in thresholds.toml rather than in any prompt.
acceptance: harness decide SEEN-088 --question risk appends a decision record carrying the model, the question, the per-option probabilities, the threshold applied and the outcome: evidenced by the record and its test
advance from clarify is refused below the clarified threshold of 0.8 and the refusal names the open question from the record: evidenced by the test and the refusal message
advance from solution adds the security checklist and a second reviewer to the review template when touches_billing_or_policy_gate is yes: evidenced by the generated draft
With no key, every decision point asks the human and records fallback: human rather than failing: evidenced by the test and by this ticket's own journal, which will contain exactly such records
The key is read from .env.local first and the environment second, and a test proves no decision record can contain the key or any environment value: evidenced by that test
decisions: The credential in this shell is rejected by the API (record 3), so the live call is built behind a transport seam and left unverified until a valid Jev credential exists. The human-fallback path is delivered working, because the ticket requires it in its own right and the harness uses it whenever the API is unavailable. Founder, 23 September 2026

The whole stage record is sent as state, per the ticket: it is internal working text with no credentials and no customer data, and a redacted digest would have Jev judging a label rather than the work. Founder, 23 September 2026

The key is read from .env.local first and the environment second, and .env.local is written from the JEV_AI_API_KEY already present, so the ticket's intent holds without breaking what exists. Founder, 23 September 2026
Probing the API with a throwaway question carrying no repository content was authorised before the first call. Founder, 23 September 2026
The question named touches_billing_or_gate in the original ticket is touches_billing_or_policy_gate, renamed when CONTEXT.md retired bare 'gate'
graph_impact: evaluate() in harness/gates.py is called by advance() and indirectly by execute(): the decision layer hangs off the stage gates, so both are touched
The templates are read by gates.load_template, which is where a second reviewer would be added to the review template
